svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Component · PicPlace account · signed-in · phone
svg.desc: Mirrors the PICPLACE card in Settings — PicPlaceSettingsCard in App/PicPlace/PicPlaceViews.swift (LLRow rows in one llCard) — the optional cloud tier, signed in, this library connected and its first connection run. Rows in the code's order: Account (the PicPlace username) · This device (the name this install registered under — what other devices see in a project's Also on row and in the server's device list) · On PicPlace (how many of this library's projects have a copy there and their bytes, with the tally line under it: originals for N · N not on PicPlace yet — at this width the tally and the value share the row and BOTH wrap, SwiftUI splitting the HStack between them) · the first-connection row in its done-with-problems state (what still stands failed, live, and Try again — the pending · comparing · sending · in-step · failed states are undrawn) · the auto-sync switches, shown once the first connection is done: Sync changes automatically (on by default once a library is connected), Only on Wi-Fi (on by default), UPLOAD BLENDS AUTOMATICALLY (2026-09-25, plan §11 stage 3 D1: every blend goes up as it is made, under every rule an automatic send keeps — on by default, per device and per library, disabled while Sync changes automatically is off) and Upload originals automatically (off by default, always; disabled while Sync changes automatically is off) · Server (read-only while signed in; the row exists on the Mac and in a Debug Simulator build only — PicPlaceConfiguration.showsServerSetting) · Sign Out… in record red, which revokes THIS device's tokens on the server and keeps every local file. Not drawn here, though the same state shows them: the Library row (Library “name” · Connected on … · @user on host) between On PicPlace and the first-connection row; the Auto-sync status and Auto-sync problem rows under the switches; the free-up-space rows (Remove originals already on PicPlace · the running and result rows · N projects' originals aren't on PicPlace yet — Upload) and Check PicPlace now between the switches and Server; Disconnect this library… (iOS, bound) above Sign Out…. Signed out: picplace-account.signed-out.phone.svg. Sign in opens ASWebAuthenticationSession on the server's /oauth/authorize (PKCE); the consent screen is the server's own page, so no mirror exists for it here. Sits between STORAGE and ADVANCED: it is about where projects live. Shared by the Mac (Settings shares the iOS spec).
